svg.text: Row 91: the decoder karma run lost its headless Chrome 101 in 10 of 33 runs
One row per run (every decoder log of the scratchpad, 19 to 20 November, time order); one column per spec, in run order.
Lost before: JPEG-LS 5x, JPEG XL 2x, HTJ2K 2x, JPEG 1 (lossy) 1x. No spec failed by its check in these runs; in each folder a later run passed all 18.
Excluded: lanePF/karma/decoders-alone.log (0 passed, 19 failed: the fixture URL bug that lane P-F fixed, not a lost browser).
Source: the decoder logs named on the left (decoders-N.log of int-*, karma-decoders*.log of the lanes), parsed by laneV1/scripts/karma_runs.py.
